## Change summary

Describe the problem, the change, and what is intentionally out of scope.

## Verification performed

List exact tests, reference comparisons, or checks actually performed and their results. State what remains unverified. Use "not applicable" where appropriate.

## Statistical and data impact (if applicable)

- Authoritative source, release/vintage, and definition/version:
- Population, time period, geographic scope, and units affected:
- Reference-result reconciliation and uncertainty:
- Canonical definition preserved? If extending, identify parent and new derived version:
- Comparability or API contract changes:

See the [statistical integrity policy](https://github.com/open-economic-metrics/.github/blob/main/STATISTICAL_INTEGRITY.md).

## Rights and safety (if applicable)

Identify new dependencies, third-party data, licensing, attribution, redistribution, privacy, or security implications.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope and supporting evidence are documented.
- [ ] Relevant tests were executed and results reported (or their absence explained).
- [ ] Documentation, schemas, and versioning were updated where required.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or unauthorized third-party datasets are included.
